_note: 인피니티 101웨이브 몬스터의 영문 묘사(desc)와 보행 방식(gait: biped·quad·fly·slither·float). 이름·등급·이동·단계·팔레트는 content.js INF_MONSTERS / INF_PALETTE 가 원본이고, tools/inf-jobs.mjs 가 둘을 합쳐 잡 파일을 만든다. 색은 적지 않는다 — 단계 팔레트가 프롬프트에 붙는다.

1.name: 역병쥐
1.desc: A mangy plague rat the size of a dog, patchy fur with bald sores, glowing eyes, yellow teeth bared, dragging a short rusted chain from a collar. Small, fast, harmless-looking but sick.

2.name: 해골 잡졸
2.desc: A small skeleton footman, brittle yellowed bones, a dented iron kettle helm, a torn tabard, holding a broken spear shaft. Hunched, light, clattering.

3.name: 묘지 오우거
3.desc: A hulking bloated grave ogre, stitched skin, a sack hood with one eye hole, a heavy wooden club studded with nails resting on the shoulder. Slow and massive.

4.name: 까마귀 정찰병
4.desc: A ragged raven scout in flight, a tiny leather harness carrying a small dim lantern, one glowing eye, tattered feathers.

5.name: 고블린 창병
5.desc: A goblin spearman, sickly skin, patched leather armor, a crude iron spear and a small round wooden shield, a sneering grin with a broken tooth. Wiry.

6.name: 썩은 멧돼지
6.desc: A rotting wild boar, ribs showing through torn hide, rusted iron caps on its tusks, one ear missing, black bile dripping from the jaw. Heavy, charging low.

7.name: 무덤 파는 구울
7.desc: A grave-digging ghoul, hunched with long clawed hands caked in soil, a tattered burial shroud, a broken shovel slung on its back, mouth full of grave dirt. Big and stooped.

8.name: 시체파리 떼
8.desc: A dense swarm of corpse flies clustered around a floating cracked skull, compound eyes glinting, a few flies trailing behind. Small and buzzing.

9.name: 녹슨 철갑 오크
9.desc: An orc brute in rusted, dented plate armor with a chipped tower shield strapped to one arm, dragging a chained cleaver, jaw tusks and a scarred face. Massive.

10.name: 역병 쥐왕
10.bossDesc: The Plague Rat King: a gigantic scarred rat wearing a rusted iron crown, a dozen tails knotted together into a swollen mass behind it, glowing eyes, a collar of skulls on a chain, standing atop a mound of bones and refuse.
